# HyCanvas binary admission

Do not put an arbitrary downloaded binary here.

1. Download the release asset for the exact office OS/architecture from HyCanvas v0.3.9.
2. Download the release `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
3. Verify checksum out of band.
4. Record the asset URL, digest, release date, and verifier in the Phase 0 report.
5. Rename/copy the verified executable to `deployment/vendor/hycanvas/hycanvas`.
6. Build the candidate container and execute the complete proof sprint.

The binary is intentionally not redistributed in this documentation package.
